svg.aria-label: gather: Research intake for gated APIs, JS pages and scanned PDFs. Five bundles of lines, solid, dashed, dotted, wavy and stepped, sweep in from the right and pass through a ring into one bright core. One line stops at the ring with a short cross mark.
